advogalia.name: Advogalia
advogalia.about: Advogalia is a Brazilian legal practice platform for law offices to manage cases, CRM clients, deadlines, hearings and court notices (intimações).

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.about: Bots on Telegram are small applications that run entirely within the platform and can be designed to support any kind of task or service.

details.description: Runs when a new deadline, hearing or task is created, optionally for a chosen type or case.
Send a reply to a specific message in a Telegram chat.
Runs when a new client is added to the CRM, optionally of a chosen relationship type.
Runs when a new case is created in your Advogalia office.
